headline: Architecture readiness is progressing, with ownership validation still open
executive_summary: The initial application inventory is 80% complete [S1:L2]. Ownership validation remains outstanding for 12 applications [S1:L3], and the steering group has approved a two-week extension [S1:L4].

key_findings.statement: The application inventory is 80% complete across the initial scope.
Twelve application owners still require validation.
